notes.title: Patch Notes #5
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478469/73a151f39167cf2759428c5a52c9aa10f8d995e9.jpg[/img]
Hello folks, we have some news! We are preparing for full release!
We are also changing game title to Secret Saga Xamadeon Stone because we think it reflects story better.

Fixed graphic and sound errors.
We have added new languages to game. Thanks for all supports from translators!

notes.title: New update is live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478469/1fe3d39e53505625a03b0dc8d89fef4aac3c1c49.png[/img]

Hello folks! You couldn't hear from us for a long time. That's because I lost my beloved grandfather and grandmother in two months. I needed some time to recover. I am very sorry that I couldn't let you guys know. I am fine now and have some good news! Color level update is available! I hope you guys enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34478469/846d925207d46cc04addacd8d25a36ca48325b9f.png[/img]
Changelog
[list]
[*] One color level added
[*] Map-key problem solved.
[*] Game crash fixed.
[*] Various bug and layer fixes.
[/list]
